comparison.objective: Insert one phase busbar into four push-in circuit-breaker terminals.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous multi-fork alignment and distributed upward press-fit insertion.
comparison.success_condition: All four forks fully home, released, and retained under a 5 N tug; bent forks or moved breakers fail.
comparison.reason: Tests parallel multi-terminal insertion and retention, rather than sequential fracture of sacrificial tangs and physical fragment recovery.
